summary: The compliance review of the HomeFix Loans: Key Facts Statement Design identified several gaps against the reviewed RBI rules. The findings include low and medium severity issues related to data localization and transparency of data processing, as well as medium severity issues regarding the loan agreement and KFS validity period. High severity issues were found related to the absence of APR computation and amortisation schedule, and the omission of the 2% processing fee in the KFS. These findings highlight the need for improvements in the KFS design to ensure full compliance with RBI regulations.
